description: This source file defines the OrderSearchCriteriaBuilder class, which is a convenience builder for constructing instances of OrderSearchCriteria. It provides methods to set various search parameters for querying orders within the OpenMRS system, such as patient, visit, care setting, concepts, order types, dates, status flags, and more. The class follows a builder pattern, enabling fluent method chaining to configure search criteria before creating an immutable instance.

classes.name: OrderSearchCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to construct OrderSearchCriteria objects with flexible filtering options for order queries.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient for whom the order search should be performed.

methods.name: setVisit
methods.description: Sets the visit context for the order search, introduced in version 2.7.0.

methods.name: setCareSetting
methods.description: Specifies the care setting to filter orders.

methods.name: setConcepts
methods.description: Defines the collection of concepts that the order must be associated with.

methods.name: setOrderTypes
methods.description: Defines the collection of order types to filter.

methods.name: setAccessionNumber
methods.description: Sets the accession number for matching orders (exact, case-insensitive).

methods.name: setOrderNumber
methods.description: Sets the order number for matching orders (exact, case-insensitive).

methods.name: setActivatedOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Filters orders activated on or before the specified date.

methods.name: setActivatedOnOrAfterDate
methods.description: Filters orders activated on or after the specified date.

methods.name: setIsStopped
methods.description: Filters orders based on whether they are stopped.

methods.name: setAutoExpireOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Filters orders set to auto-expire on or before the specified date.

methods.name: setCanceledOrExpiredOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Filters orders that are canceled or expired on or before the specified date.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Filters orders by the specified action.

methods.name: setFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Filters orders by the specified fulfiller status.

methods.name: setIncludeNullFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Includes orders with null fulfiller status if set to true.

methods.name: setExcludeCanceledAndExpired
methods.description: Excludes canceled and expired orders if set to true.

methods.name: setExcludeDiscontinueOrders
methods.description: Excludes discontinue orders if set to true.

methods.name: setIncludeVoided
methods.description: Includes voided orders if set to true.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an OrderSearchCriteria object with the configured properties.
